title: Edamame Fried Rice with Egg
description: Day-old rice fried with edamame, scrambled egg and scallions in a light soy sauce.
steps: Scramble the eggs lightly and set aside.
Fry the garlic and edamame briefly, then add the cold rice, breaking up any clumps.
Stir through the soy sauce, scallions and scrambled egg to finish.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food vegetarian recipe collection

notes: Cold, day-old rice fries up far better than fresh — plan a batch of rice the night before.
